接触包装前就开始录像，直到开机前不要停：拍清盒子六个面、纸质拉条、盒上序列号并核: Start recording before you touch the packaging and keep recording until the Mac is powered on: show all six sides of the box, the paper pull tab, and the serial number on the box, then verify it matches the machine.
开封前开始录制：在接触包装之前就开录，清晰展示密封状态与包装盒六个面。: Start recording before opening: begin filming before you touch the packaging and clearly show the seals and all six sides of the box.
检查包装完整性：约 2022 年起的较新包装已无塑封膜、改为纸质拉条，确认拉条或: Check that the packaging is intact: newer boxes from around 2022 on have no shrink wrap and use a paper pull tab instead, so confirm the tab or wrap is undamaged and shows no sign of being resealed.
记录序列号：清晰拍摄盒上序列号，开箱后与机身序列号对比——必须完全一致。: Record the serial number: film the serial number on the box clearly, then compare it with the serial number on the machine after unboxing — they must match exactly.
核对配件清单：电源适配器功率、充电线与说明文档是否符合 Apple 官方规格。: Check the included accessories: confirm that the power adapter wattage, charging cable, and documentation match Apple's official specifications.
一镜到底不中断：全程不要停止录制，口述观察内容可增加视频可信度。: Keep one continuous take: never stop recording, and narrating what you see makes the video more credible.
保留原始未剪辑视频，作为退换货或维权凭证。: Keep the original unedited video as evidence for a return or a dispute.
确认「查找我的 Mac」已关闭，抹机后不再索要前机主 Apple 账户密码。: Confirm that Find My Mac is turned off and that the erased Mac no longer asks for the previous owner's Apple Account password.
系统设置 › Apple 账户 › iCloud › 查找：确认「查找我的 Ma: Go to System Settings › Apple Account › iCloud › Find My and confirm that Find My Mac is turned off.
让卖家当面执行「抹掉所有内容和设置」，重启进入设置助理。: Have the seller erase all content and settings in front of you, then restart into Setup Assistant.
设置助理若仍要求输入前机主 Apple 账户密码 = 激活锁未解除，绝对不能付款: If Setup Assistant still asks for the previous owner's Apple Account password, Activation Lock has not been removed and you must not pay.
右侧硬件快照已自动读取系统激活锁状态，可辅助核对。: The hardware snapshot on the right already reads the system Activation Lock status and can help you cross-check.
终端核验 + 抹机后联网复验，出现「远程管理」页即为企业监管机。: Verify in Terminal, then re-check while online after erasing: a Remote Management screen means the Mac is enrolled in corporate management.
终端执行：profiles status -type enrollment，两行: Run profiles status -type enrollment in Terminal; both lines must read No.
更可靠的方法：抹机后联网进入设置助理，若出现「远程管理」页面即为企业注册机。: For a more reliable check, erase the Mac and go through Setup Assistant while online; a Remote Management page means it is enrolled by a company.
企业监管机可能被远程锁定或抹除，不要购买；右侧快照已自动核验一次。: A managed Mac can be locked or erased remotely, so do not buy it; the snapshot on the right has already checked once.
系统、机身底壳、包装盒三处序列号必须完全一致。: The serial number must match exactly in all three places: macOS, the bottom case, and the box.
系统设置 › 通用 › 关于本机：读出序列号（右侧快照也已自动读取）。: Open System Settings › General › About and read the serial number (the snapshot on the right reads it automatically too).
与机身底部刻印比对（若底壳更换过则无刻印，需追问原因）。: Compare it with the engraving on the bottom case (a replaced bottom case has no engraving, so ask why).
与包装盒标签比对，三处一致才算通过。: Compare it with the label on the box; the item passes only if all three match.
再到 Apple「检查覆盖范围」页面输入序列号，核对机型与保修状态是否匹配。: Then enter the serial number on Apple's Check Coverage page and confirm that the model and warranty status match.
「部件与维修」查看是否换过屏幕/电池，配件是否正品 Apple 部件。: Use Parts & Service to see whether the display or battery was replaced and whether the parts are genuine Apple parts.
系统设置 › 通用 › 关于本机 › 部件与维修：查看维修记录。: Open System Settings › General › About › Parts & Service to review the service history.
部件会标注「正品 Apple 部件 / 二手 Apple 部件 / 未知或未验证: Each part is labeled Genuine Apple Part, Used Apple Part, or Unknown or Unverified.
该入口只在检测到维修时显示；没有入口一般说明无维修记录。: This section appears only when a repair is detected; if it is missing, there is usually no service history.
出现未说明的换屏、换电池记录需向卖家追问，或直接放弃。: If there is an unexplained display or battery replacement, question the seller or walk away.
关机拔外设后进诊断模式，参考代码 ADP000 表示未发现问题。: Shut down, unplug external devices, and enter Diagnostics mode; the reference code ADP000 means no issues were found.
关机：完全关闭 MacBook；运行前断开所有外部设备，仅保留键盘、鼠标、显示器: Shut down: power the MacBook off completely; before running the test, disconnect all external devices except the keyboard, mouse, display, Ethernet, and power adapter.
启动诊断 · Apple 芯片：按住电源键直到看到启动选项，然后按 Comman: Start diagnostics on Apple silicon: hold the power button until startup options appear, then press Command (⌘) + D.
启动诊断 · Intel 芯片：开机后立即按住 D；如果无效，再尝试 Optio: Start diagnostics on Intel: hold D immediately after powering on; if that does not work, try Option (⌥) + D.
按提示操作：依系统版本可能先要求选择语言，或选择要运行的检测项目。: Follow the on-screen prompts: depending on the macOS version, you may first choose a language or select which tests to run.
查看结果：记录参考代码（ADP000 = 未发现问题），其他代码即对应硬件故障，: Review the results: note the reference code (ADP000 = no issues found); any other code points to a hardware fault, so ask the seller about each one, then choose Restart or Shut Down on screen.
黑/白/红/绿/蓝逐色找固定亮点、暗点与色斑。: Cycle through black, white, red, green, and blue to look for stuck bright dots, dark dots, and blotches.
点「开始」进入全屏纯色画面，空格或 → 切换颜色，Esc 退出。: Click Start to enter the full-screen solid colors; press Space or → to change color and Esc to exit.
逐色观察是否有固定不变的亮点（卡点）或黑点（坏点）。: In each color, look for bright dots that never change (stuck pixels) or dark dots (dead pixels).
再在全黑房间把亮度调到最高，看四角是否有明显漏光。: Then, in a completely dark room with brightness at maximum, check the corners for obvious backlight bleed.
轻擦屏幕，查看防反射镀膜是否脱落（2012–2019 款高发）。: Wipe the display lightly and check whether the anti-reflective coating is peeling (common on 2012–2019 models).
关闭屏幕，用超细纤维布轻擦屏幕表面。: Turn the display off and wipe its surface gently with a microfiber cloth.
斜角光线下观察是否有彩虹纹、起皮、脱落斑块。: Look at the display under angled light for rainbow marks, flaking, or patches where the coating has come off.
主要影响 2012–2019 款机型，脱落面积大不建议购买。: This mainly affects 2012–2019 models; if a large area has come off, do not buy the Mac.
用无纺布轻压屏幕四角，观察是否出现黑斑。: Press the four corners of the display gently through a non-woven cloth and watch for dark patches.
用无纺布或超细纤维布轻压屏幕四角与边缘。: Press the four corners and edges of the display gently with a non-woven or microfiber cloth.
观察是否出现黑斑、水波纹样扩散。: Watch for dark spots or ripples that spread like water.
松手后应在数秒内完全恢复；出现永久暗斑说明屏幕已受损。: The image should fully recover within seconds of releasing; a permanent dark patch means the display is damaged.
查「部件与维修」+ True Tone/自动亮度是否可用 + 边框撬痕。: Check Parts & Service, whether True Tone and auto-brightness work, and whether the bezel shows pry marks.
macOS 26 及以上：系统设置 › 通用 › 关于本机 › 部件与维修，显示: On macOS 26 and later, open System Settings › General › About › Parts & Service; if the display appears in the list it has been replaced (only M5 and newer models log the display).
更早机型：看 True Tone 原彩显示与自动亮度是否可用——本应支持却没有，: On earlier models, check whether True Tone and auto-brightness work — if the model should support them but they are missing, the display is usually not original.
仔细观察屏幕四周边框有无撬压痕迹、胶痕、缝隙不均。: Look closely around the bezel for pry marks, adhesive residue, or uneven gaps.
暗环境下纯黑画面、亮度拉满，检查四边四角是否漏光。: In a dark room with a pure black screen at maximum brightness, check the edges and corners for light leaks.
在全黑房间，显示纯黑画面（可用坏点检测的全屏黑）。: In a completely dark room, display a pure black screen (the full-screen black of the dead pixel test works).
亮度调到最高，从正面与侧面观察四边四角。: Set brightness to maximum and check the edges and corners from the front and from the side.
轻微均匀的边缘泛光属正常；局部喷溅状亮斑属异常。: Faint, even glow along the edges is normal; localized splash-shaped bright patches are not.
测试最大/最小亮度与自动亮度传感器。: Test maximum and minimum brightness and the auto-brightness sensor.
用 F1 / F2 走完亮度全行程，观察是否有跳变或闪烁。: Press F1 / F2 through the full brightness range and watch for jumps or flicker.
开启自动亮度，用手遮挡光感应区（屏幕上方），亮度应明显变化。: Turn on auto-brightness and cover the ambient light sensor above the screen with your hand; brightness should change noticeably.
最高亮度下与同机型对比，明显偏暗说明背光老化。: At maximum brightness, compare with the same model; if it is clearly dimmer, the backlight has aged.
绘制图案检查各区域跟踪与响应，再测双指滚动与用力点按。: Draw patterns to check tracking and response across the whole surface, then test two-finger scrolling and a force click.
点「开始」在画布上单指连续画圈与四角直线：应跟手、无断线。: Click Start, then draw continuous circles and lines into all four corners with one finger: the cursor should follow smoothly with no breaks.
覆盖四个角与边缘，检查是否存在无响应区域。: Cover all four corners and the edges to check for areas that do not respond.
再测双指滚动、三指拖动与用力点按（Force Touch）手感是否一致。: Then test two-finger scrolling, three-finger dragging, and force clicking (Force Touch) for a consistent feel.
内置拟真键盘画布：逐个按键实时点亮并计数，不触发或串键即为故障。: The built-in realistic keyboard canvas lights up and counts every key in real time; keys that do not respond or that trigger the wrong key are faults.
点「开始」后在画布上按顺序敲击每个按键（含功能键与方向键）。: Click Start, then press every key on the canvas in order, including the function and arrow keys.
被按下的键应实时点亮并计数；未点亮的键即为不触发。: Every key you press should light up and be counted in real time; a key that never lights up does not register.
注意检查串键（按 A 亮 B）与连击。: Also watch for wrong-key output (pressing A lights up B) and double presses.
录入一枚新指纹并实际解锁，应一次成功。: Enroll a new fingerprint and unlock with it; it should work on the first try.
系统设置 › Touch ID 与密码：录入一枚新指纹。: Open System Settings › Touch ID & Password and enroll a new fingerprint.
锁屏后用该指纹解锁，应一次识别成功。: Lock the screen and unlock with that fingerprint; it should be recognized on the first try.
反复 5 次观察识别率，明显迟钝可能是传感器老化。: Repeat five times to check the recognition rate; if it is clearly slow, the sensor may be worn.
依次播放 左→中→右 提示音，定位清晰、无破音异响。: Play the left, center, and right tones in turn; each should be clearly positioned with no distortion or rattle.
点「开始」依次播放左 / 中 / 右三声提示音。: Click Start to play the left, center, and then right tone.
确认左右声道定位清晰、音量均衡、无破音与杂音。: Confirm that the left and right channels are clearly positioned, evenly loud, and free of distortion and noise.
播放一段熟悉的音乐，注意是否有共振、金属杂音。: Play a piece of music you know well and listen for resonance or metallic rattling.
录制并回放，检查内置麦克风是否正常。: Record and play back to check that the built-in microphone works.
点「开始」录制约 5 秒，随后自动回放。: Click Start to record for about five seconds; playback starts automatically.
回放应清晰、无明显底噪或断续；首次使用会请求麦克风权限。: Playback should be clear with no obvious background noise or dropouts; the first run asks for microphone permission.
靠近左右麦克风孔说话分别测试，回放应有对应强弱。: Speak close to the left and right microphone openings in turn; playback should be louder on the matching side.
查看实时画面：清晰、无横纹黑块。: Check the live image: it should be sharp with no horizontal lines or black blocks.
点「开始」打开实时预览窗口（首次会请求摄像头权限）。: Click Start to open the live preview window (the first run asks for camera permission).
画面应清晰、色彩正常、无横纹、黑块或彩点。: The image should be sharp with normal color and no horizontal lines, black blocks, or colored dots.
用手遮挡镜头再移开，观察曝光响应是否正常。: Cover the lens with your hand and then move it away to check that exposure responds normally.
每个口分别测数据传输、外接显示与充电，松旷即异常。: Test data transfer, external display output, and charging on every port; a loose fit is a fault.
每个 USB-C / 雷电口分别插入 U 盘，确认能正常读写文件。: Plug a USB flash drive into each USB-C / Thunderbolt port and confirm that you can read and write files.
接外接显示器或转接器，确认视频输出正常。: Connect an external display or adapter and confirm that video output works.
接充电器，确认充电指示与功率正常；需调整角度才通电 = 接口松旷。: Connect the charger and confirm that charging and power delivery are normal; if you must wiggle the plug to get power, the port is loose.

连接 Wi-Fi，检查信号强度与实测网速是否正常。: Connect to Wi-Fi and check that signal strength and measured speed are normal.

买二手 MacBook 付款前必须检查哪些项目？: Which checks must I complete before paying for a used MacBook?
先过账户与身份关：激活锁已解除、无 MDM 企业锁、序列号三处一致（系统/机身/: Start with the account and identity checks: Activation Lock removed, no MDM enrollment, the serial number matching in all three places (macOS, chassis, and box), no unexplained repairs under Parts & Service, and Apple Diagnostics returning ADP000. Then look for physical damage: whether the display is original, signs of liquid damage, dead pixels, the speakers, microphone, and camera, and battery health. Once everything passes, erase the disk and reinstall last. Do not pay if any Must-check item fails; the remaining keyboard, port, and chassis checks are optional.
怎么判断 MacBook 有没有激活锁？: How can I tell whether a MacBook has Activation Lock?
系统设置 › 你的名字 › iCloud › 查找我的 Mac，确认已关闭且系统: Open System Settings › your name › iCloud › Find My Mac and confirm that it is off and that the previous owner's Apple Account no longer appears in the system. The safest approach is to have the seller erase all content and settings in front of you; the Mac is only truly unlocked if Setup Assistant does not ask for the previous owner's password. Never buy a Mac that still has Activation Lock.
怎么检查 MacBook 是否被企业 MDM 管理？: How do I check whether a MacBook is managed by corporate MDM?
在终端运行 profiles status -type enrollment，两: Run profiles status -type enrollment in Terminal; both lines must read No. A more reliable method is to erase the Mac and go through Setup Assistant while online: a Remote Management page means it is enrolled in corporate management, and such machines can be locked or erased remotely, so do not buy them.
怎么判断 MacBook 屏幕是不是原装？: How do I tell whether a MacBook display is original?
macOS 26 及以上先看 系统设置 › 通用 › 关于本机 › 部件与维修，: On macOS 26 and later, first check System Settings › General › About › Parts & Service; if the display appears in the list it has been replaced (only M5 and newer models log the display). On earlier models, check whether True Tone and auto-brightness are available: if the model should support them but the option is missing, the display was probably replaced with a non-original part, which you can confirm by looking for pry marks on the bezel.
MacBook 屏幕坏点怎么检测？: How do I test a MacBook display for dead pixels?
用坏点检测页全屏切换红、绿、蓝、白、黑纯色画面，逐色观察有没有固定不变的亮点或黑: Use the dead pixel test to switch the full screen through solid red, green, blue, white, and black, checking each color for bright or dark dots that never change. Then, in a completely dark room with brightness at maximum, check the corners for obvious backlight bleed; faint, even edge glow is normal.
怎么查看 MacBook 的维修记录？: How do I check a MacBook's service history?
macOS 26 及以上进入 系统设置 › 通用 › 关于本机 › 部件与维修，: On macOS 26 and later, open System Settings › General › About › Parts & Service, which lists detected repairs and labels parts as Genuine Apple Part, Used Apple Part, or Unknown or Unverified. This section appears only when a repair is detected, so if it is missing there is usually no service history.

先关机并拔掉除电源外的所有外设。Apple 芯片机型按住电源键直到出现启动选项，: First shut down and unplug every peripheral except the power adapter.
